1.title: Andrew Bailey, a Deputy Director at the F.B.I., Leaves His Job
1.summary: Mr. Bailey, who was part of a three-person leadership team atop the bureau, lasted barely a year.

2.title: Trump Offered to Sell Arms to China, U.S. Ambassador Says
2.summary: President Trump made the offer to Xi Jinping, China’s leader, said David Perdue, the ambassador to China. The White House later said the U.S. had no plans for such a sale.

4.title: Brazil’s Biggest Election Question?: Donald Trump’s Next Move
4.summary: As Brazil prepares to hold elections next month, Latin America’s biggest nation is taking steps to shield its democracy from potential American meddling.

5.title: Pope Leo Praises Europe’s Democracy, Diverging Once Again From Trump
5.summary: Speaking in France, the pontiff lauded postwar efforts to unify the continent. Experts saw it as a critique of President Trump’s repeated berating of European leaders.

6.title: Possible Terrorist Plot at R.A.F. Fairford Air Base in U.K.: What We Know
6.summary: Five British men were arrested as they approached R.A.F. Fairford, a base used by the United States in its war against Iran. The men are being held on suspicion of terrorism.
